scoring_justification: Checker recomputes each value using analytic formulas with v=0.2 and compares to hidden gold derived from the paper; T0 result-level compare because the artifact is a single static JSON of numeric constants.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for each quantity derived from paper-reported formulas and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and equations; values extracted for v=0.2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's equations (6), (12)-(13), (16)-(17) and stated displacement ratios. All numbers are exact analytic constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual headline quantities, verifiable from the paper.

hollow_ww_at_0.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle 0 for hollow cavity, ratio of applied stress p

hollow_ww_at_pi2.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle pi/2 for hollow cavity, ratio of p

water_ww_at_0.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle 0 for water-filled cavity, ratio of p

water_ww_at_pi2.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle pi/2 for water-filled cavity, ratio of p

internal_pressure_q.description: internal cavity pressure q, ratio of p

tension_hollow_ww_at_0.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle 0 for hollow cavity under uniaxial tension, ratio of |p|

tension_water_ww_at_0.description: hoop stress ww at cavity surface and angle 0 for water-filled cavity under uniaxial tension, ratio of |p|

outputs.description: Compiled dimensionless results from the elastic analysis of hollow and water-filled spherical cavities under uniaxial compression and tension.

output_contract.notes: All stresses are reported as ratios of the applied remote uniaxial stress magnitude. The numerical values correspond to Poisson's ratio v = 0.2 for the concrete matrix. The displacement ratios follow the cubic element model and are based on the given analytic formulas for D/L = 0.5 and 0.667.
